evidence_spans: The selection hardware adds only 3.7% to the accelerator area.
The hardware is written in SystemVerilog and synthesized with Cadence Genus on TSMC 16 nm at 250 MHz and 0.75 V, like our ANDA implementation.
CLM-ARCH-0252.statement: The Kameleo selection hardware adds 3.7% to the accelerator area.

extra_quotes: The hardware is written in SystemVerilog and synthesized with Cadence Genus on TSMC 16 nm at 250 MHz and 0.75 V, like our ANDA implementation. Power is estimated from switching activity recorded in VCD files during simulation.
